runtime: Reuse tools.unprepared_challenge freeze/run with isolated baseline,updated,BM25 and keyword arms; sources and budgets identical; expected answers outside runtime.
packets: tools.blind_archival_packets exports anonymous paired familiar development outputs without reference drafts or implementation labels. Familiar packets are not an unseen evaluation.
scoring: Compatible collection review templates use existing tools.unprepared_challenge score requiring two real human submissions and bound adjudication for disagreements. Participant identities/independence are not authenticated by code. A fresh model review must be labelled AI assessment and cannot satisfy the human validator.
publication_rule: Retain all cases including errors, partials, wrong answers and over-refusals. Keep unknown values null. Never count a downloaded article or search result as a review of MPLPB output.
